description: Writes, reviews and scores job descriptions: scopes the role, separates true requirements from preferences, removes exclusionary or inflated wording, aligns the posting with the job leveling framework, and checks it against EU Pay Transparency Directive (2023/970) expectations such as pay range disclosure. Use when someone asks to draft a job ad or job posting, rewrite or audit an existing job description, make a posting more inclusive, trim requirements, or prepare postings for pay transparency rules.
